critique: The seamless overlay of the flat-shaded, geometric SVG fox motif against the procedurally generated, undulating canvas terrain successfully blends organic landscape rhythms with sharp digital abstraction. However, relying on external image assets (`art.png` and `guineapig.png`) breaks the self-contained generative illusion; rendering these subjects natively through WebGL shaders or intricate CSS polygons would dramatically heighten the work's technical boldness and aesthetic cohesion.
